name: prism-vault-store
title: Prism Vault Store
purpose: Decides whether the browser vault may keep one value, as its value or as a hash only, so that nothing is kept that the Boundary refused, that the owner has not yet approved, or that does not re-derive to the address it is filed under.

fields.name: boundary
fields.means: the Boundary's answer for this value with destination browser

fields.name: key
fields.means: whether the browser still holds the vault's own non-extractable key

fields.name: address
fields.means: whether the address the value is filed under re-derives from its bytes under the vault key

fields.name: room
fields.means: whether the browser's storage quota has room for the sealed bytes

rules.says: when key is missing then refuse
rules.why: nothing can be sealed without the key

rules.says: when address is mismatch then refuse
when boundary is deny then refuse
when room is full then refuse
rules.why: a partial write is never kept

rules.says: when boundary is ask then ask
when boundary is hashonly then storehash
when boundary is allow then store

properties.says: always when address is mismatch then refuse
properties.why: a value filed under an address it does not re-derive to could stand in for another

properties.says: always when boundary is deny then refuse
properties.why: the vault never keeps what the Boundary refused

properties.says: never when boundary is hashonly then store
properties.why: regulated and restricted data is never kept as a value

properties.says: never when key is missing then store
properties.why: nothing is ever written in the clear

properties.says: never when boundary is ask then store
properties.why: nothing waiting on the owner is kept before they approve

meanings.store: seal and keep the value at its address
meanings.storehash: keep only the hash and a pointer to the original

limits: It does not compute the address or seal the bytes; the adapter does that with WebCrypto and reports the result.
It does not ask the owner; ask means the adapter must get approval and then ask the Boundary again.
Storage being made persistent is reported, not required: a value is kept even if the browser may evict it.
